subject: Ambulance Service Provider Transition
overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole conducted a comprehensive review of the planned transition of municipal ambulance services from Armstrong Ambulance to Cataldo Ambulance, resulting in a formal request for the Mayor to pause the transition. The Council also voted to adjust and repost the recruitment listing for the vacant City Clerk position.

items.title: Ambulance Service Transition Review
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting that the Mayor pause the scheduled January 19, 2026 transition of EMS services to Cataldo Ambulance, and approved requests for extensive operational, financial, and legal records from the administration and Armstrong Ambulance.

items.title: Standard Compensation Ordinance
items.summary: Tabled the standard compensation ordinance to a future committee meeting.

items.title: City Clerk Recruitment Process
items.summary: Approved a motion to repost the City Clerk vacancy without minimum requirements through February 6, 2026, to attract a wider pool of applicants.
